project_name: ANORA — Premium Luxury Women's Fashion E-Commerce

design_philosophy.inspiration: The Collective (organized multi-category luxury discovery), Louis Vuitton (immersive editorial campaigns & elegant PDP), Prada (minimalist, generous whitespace, sharp serif & clean sans typography)
core_principles: Tactile Craftsmanship: Blend Jaipur regal architecture with high-fashion minimalism
Whitespace as Luxury: Generous padding, no cramped layouts or excessive badges
Editorial Storytelling: Full-bleed campaign media, serif typography, 3:4 portrait ratios
Sophisticated Micro-interactions: Fluid drawer slide-outs, secondary image hover switch, elegant pin code validator

theme.mode: Light Luxury Editorial (Default) with Dark Luxury Accent Surfaces

typography.heading_font: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, or serif fallback

scales.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-light leading-tight
scales.caption: text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-sans text-stone-500

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use 2x-3x generous spacing (py-16 to py-28 for sections, gap-8 to gap-12 for grids)
layout_and_spacing.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8
layout_and_spacing.aspect_ratios: Product images MUST strictly use 3:4 portrait ratio (aspect-[3/4])

header.announcement_bar: Slim top banner in deep charcoal (#1A1918) with champagne text, key messaging (e.g. Complimentary Jaipur Artisan Express Shipping)
header.navigation: Clean centered logo badge, horizontal links (New In, Clothing, Dresses, Co-ord Sets, Tops, Occasionwear, Collections, Sale) with hover underline animation, icon triggers for Search, Account, Wishlist, Bag
header.mega_menu: Hover-activated mega menu for category discovery with featured editorial banner

homepage_sections: Hero Editorial Campaign (Full width 85vh, subtle parallax zoom, serif title, double CTAs)
Curated Category Grid (Asymmetric 3:4 cards: Jaipur Cotton Kurtis, Rayon Sets, A-Line Kurtas, Midi Dresses)
Editorial Brand Story ('Born in Jaipur — Hand-carved Block Prints & Pure Fabrics')
Artisan Craftsmanship Showcase (Fabric callouts, sustainability & luxury finish)
Newsletter Subscription with consent checkbox & discount popover trigger

shop_catalog.filters_drawer: Slide-out drawer with Category, Size (XS-3XL), Colour, Price Range, Availability, Occasion, Style filters
shop_catalog.sort_dropdown: Newest, Price: Low to High, Price: High to Low, Popularity
shop_catalog.product_card: Hover swap to 2nd model look, quick add to bag overlay button, wishlist heart toggle, subtle stock indicator, swatch dots

product_detail_page.layout: Sticky left gallery grid (large main image + zoom modal, 4 thumb views) and right sticky scroll detail column
features: Size selector with Interactive Size Guide Modal
Accordion sections (Fabric & Care, Shipping & Returns, Jaipur Artisan Notes)

slide_out_bag.contents: Item items, size edit, quantity stepper, gift wrap option, order summary, Express Checkout CTA button

account_and_admin.user_account: Tabbed layout (Orders & Tracking, Addresses, Saved Wishlist, Profile Settings)
account_and_admin.admin_dashboard: Clean metrics overview (Total Revenue, Orders, Customers), tables with status badges for Products, Orders, Banners, Newsletter subscribers, Coupons

product_catalog_images.title: Jaipur Arch Tiered Rayon Midi Dress

motion_and_micro_interactions.transitions: Use specific CSS transitions, avoid transition-all. Example: transition-[transform,opacity,color] duration-300 ease-out
motion_and_micro_interactions.drawer_animations: Slide-in right for shopping bag and filter drawer using framer-motion or CSS transitions
motion_and_micro_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap animations with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to disable scaling & continuous motions
motion_and_micro_interactions.hover_states: Product image slight zoom (scale-105 duration-700), button background shift with explicit text color contrast

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, filters, checkout fields, modal toggles, and admin actions MUST carry a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_standards: Contrast minimums >= 4.5:1 for standard text, clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-charcoal/40), explicit label associations for inputs, semantic sectioning elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact color theme, typography, and component drawer structure.
Do NOT generate generic AI slop or dark high-tech templates.
Use standard JS/JSX format for components.
Ensure all testing data-testid attributes are preserved on interactive elements.
Use Sonner for toast notifications and Shadcn UI primitives wherever applicable.
